Conditions raised by zujwt

Source: R/conditions.R
zujwt_error.Rd

Every error zujwt raises inherits from zujwt_error, then error and condition, so a caller can catch all of them, or one kind, with tryCatch(). Match on the class, never on the message.

Details

ClassFieldsRaised when
zujwt_parse_errora token, header or key is not well formed, or is over a limit
zujwt_policy_erroran algorithm is not allowed, a crit header is not understood, or a key does not fit the algorithm
zujwt_key_errora key is missing, malformed or too weak
zujwt_signature_errora signature or MAC does not verify
zujwt_decrypt_errordecryption fails, for any reason, after the header has passed the policy checks
zujwt_claim_errorclaima JWT claim is missing or does not match what the caller expects
zujwt_unsupported_erroralgorithm, needsan algorithm needs a newer zucrypt than the one installed

Every decryption failure raises the same class with the same message, so that the error cannot tell an attacker which step failed (RFC 7516 section 11.5). Messages never contain key material, decrypted bytes or token text.
